riskSignals.rationale: Current official PDF directs guests to ask about potential cross-contamination; no item-specific current cross-contact matrix is available.
EveryBite is interactive and incomplete in accessible static evidence.
Frozen baseline includes stale, renamed, seasonal, and duplicate entries relative to current menu.

findings.summary: The frozen 107-item catalog requires mechanical drift and duplicate cleanup against the current location menu.
Current public evidence does not establish complete allergen or may-contain arrays; explicit pistachio wording is preserved narrowly.

summary: Identity and location are confirmed. Current menu surfaces were inventoried, all four allergen searches were completed, and all frozen keys were reconciled exactly once. Current official allergen coverage is accurately unavailable; direct pistachio wording is preserved only where explicit.
coordinatorNotes: Research-only result; no canonical, ledger, dossier, evidence, item-check, manifest, parser, or generated data was edited.
